spec.description: The alerts in effect for one state, territory or marine area. The same as `alerts.get_active_alerts` narrowed by `area`, with the area in the path. Takes no other filter, so drills and test messages come back too; `alerts.get_active_alerts` with `status: ["actual"]` leaves them out.

area.description: Two-letter state, territory or marine-area code, such as `WA` or `PZ`. Un-enumerated for the reason `alerts.get_active_alerts` gives for `area`.

response.description: The alerts in effect for the area, as a GeoJSON feature collection. Empty when there are none.
